entities.summary: Long March 10, also known as the "Next Generation crewed launch vehicle", and previously and unofficially as the "921 rocket" or the "Long March 5G", is a Chinese super-heavy carrier rocket for crewed lunar missions that is currently under development. The nickname "921" refers to the founding date of China's human spaceflight program. In 2022, the first flight was targeted for 2027. In April 2024, it was announced that program development was complete.
